However, the Absence(target_picked_up) hard clause is correct per 'Never pick up the box'. The Absence(key_lost) soft clause matches 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed'. The compiled machine's rejecting state u1 is reached by target_picked_up, matching the hard rule. Note the rule-only warning is valid because no goal is commanded. No clause is missing or added, so the set is accepted as stated. Remove nothing; keep all three clauses.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Absence(target_picked_up) matches 'Never pick up the box'. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed'. The task sets no hard goal, so the rule-only warning and empty FINAL_STATES are valid.

Whenever the agent holds the key, try to have the door open at that time or open it later.
